# ANALYSIS: Walk-forward OOS and Real-fills Check on Top 3 J Days

**Filed:** 2026-07-16  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the current engine's performance on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) is stable across walk-forward OOS splits (P&L deviation <20% between IS and OOS) and that real-fills P&L deviates by less than 20% from BS-sim P&L on these days. This validates edge_capture stability and fill quality for OP-16 anchor days.

## Mechanism

We will conduct a walk-forward OOS test using the available history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Split methodology: train on first 70% of trading days by date, test on remaining 30% (OOS window). For each top 3 J day, we will:
1. Record engine P&L in IS period (if day falls in IS) and OOS period (if day falls in OOS).
2. Run engine on the day using real OPRA fills (cached data) and compare to BS-sim P&L.
We require <20% relative deviation in both tests for stability.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Engine uses params.json (Safe) tuned for $25K+ account to realize headline P&L. Paper trading at $1K scales to ~14% of headline P&L (qty=3 vs 28).
2. **Sample bias:** Using full 16-month history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Top 3 J days are within sample. Walk-forward split may place days in IS/OOS arbitrarily; we test stability across split. Overfit risk mitigated by OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward test pending).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (OPRA validation pending).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: If OOS P&L on any J winner drops >20% vs IS, edge_capture degrades.
   - Max drawdown: Concentrated losses on J days could trigger daily kill switch.
   - Blow-up scenario: Systematic real-fills slippage >20% on J winners turns winners to losers.
6. **Concentration:** Top 3 J days currently contribute 100% of max possible edge_capture (1542). If engine captures <80% of this, concentration risk is extreme (top 3 = >100% of actual edge_capture).

## Pre-merge gate

- Walk-forward OOS test: P&L on each top 3 J day in OOS window must be within 20% of IS P&L (if day appears in both windows; if only in one window, require OOS P&L >0 and within 20% of expected J winner P&L).
- Real-fills check: For each top 3 J day, real-fills P&L must be within 20% of BS-sim P&L.
- Gym validators: All core logic tests must pass.
- Anchor no-regression: Engine must not lose on any J winner day (P&L >=0) in OOS and real-fills.

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- No backtest results available yet. Hypothesis based on engine design principles; requires empirical validation pending.
